name: Lilongwe Wildlife Centre
subtitle: A wildlife rescue and rehabilitation sanctuary run by the Lilongwe Wildlife Trust inside a nature reserve in the middle of the capital.

facts.label: Location
facts.value: In the centre of the capital

facts.label: Role
facts.value: Only wildlife rehabilitation sanctuary in Malawi and largest environmental education centre

facts.label: Habitat
facts.value: Last Acacia combretum forest example in the Central Region

parts.text: A wildlife rescue and rehabilitation sanctuary run by the Lilongwe Wildlife Trust inside a nature reserve in the middle of the capital. It cares for injured and orphaned animals.
